gaps.question: Does the chosen balance over-represent institutional histories and famous men?

gaps.nextEvidence: Select one promising omitted-life lead (Medical Mission/John Groom or Italian community) and check the underlying local archive/history before curation; use Black Mary only with boundary and legend distinctions.
